sourceReference.role: Read-only same-identity kit and relative-proportion reference; no inheritance of its source approval or stationary span rule.

decision: Accept this exact unmodified contact/casualty source pair for the bounded opt-in v20 pilot and common-scale registration. No source-blocking defect was found. Renderer contact readability, low-alpha edge appearance and registration continuity remain required integration gates.
scope: Two exact native Confederate A east 2x2 RGBA sources, four contact endpoints and four non-graphic casualty endpoints; no default promotion or complete-family certification.
bearingAndKit: All faces/bodies remain oriented to image right; the resting figure retains head/weapon to the right. Gray cap and coat, pale buff trousers, brown boots and straps, dark pack/pouch and tan blanket roll are coherent with the viewed v18 Confederate A source. Relative head/limb/boot shapes show no obvious unrelated-character substitution, while foreshortening and overlap vary intentionally.

cells.observation: Right-facing gray-capped figure carries the same gray coat, buff trousers, brown boots/straps, dark pack/pouch and tan blanket roll as the reference. The rifle lies diagonally across the body with a rear grip near the lock/stock and a separate forward supporting hand. Both visible leg-to-boot chains are complete and planted; the front boot is higher in the oblique view. Bayonet, cap and boots fit the native cell.
cells.supportMeaning: X=260 is the manually interpreted projected pelvis center beneath the coat/belt and between the two leg origins. Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 lower edge of the nearer rear/left planted boot sole in the bounded sole-only ROI; the forward boot, pack and musket are excluded.

cells.observation: Right-facing figure makes a wider braced stance with a level, forward-pointing bayonet. Rear and forward hands remain visibly distinct and attached to the stock/fore-end; the complete legs and both boots are present. This reads as the endpoint of a short level lunge in the proposed contact sequence, but its shouldered weapon also resembles aimed fire in isolation. Source approval does not establish contact timing or impact readability.

cells.observation: Right-facing recovery lifts the weapon to a steeper diagonal and draws the hands closer to the torso while retaining two visible support grips. Complete bent leg chains and the same kit remain readable. The cap and body retain the family proportions; the elevated bayonet explains the much taller full silhouette and is deliberately excluded from human reference height.

cells.observation: Right-facing close guard places the rifle nearer the chest with elbows and hands closer in than the recovery frame. This is a subtle but separately painted guard endpoint; its usefulness as a readable transition is a playback question, not something established by pixel inequality alone.

measurementContract.source: contact only determines the shared human reference
measurementContract.method: Independently inspect the complete unresampled native sheets and each native 627-pixel cell. Select anatomical projected pelvis/support X positions manually, excluding packs and weapons; do not center alpha boxes. Select bounded cap-only and nearer supporting-sole-only rectangles for all four contact cells. Measure cap minY and sole maxYExclusive at alpha>=64; subtract to obtain [402,369,401,391], whose median is 396. Round the median half upward and apply the same referenceHeight=396 to every cell in both sources. Ground Y is recomputed separately from each role-appropriate support ROI. No per-phase or casualty height normalization, resampling, mirroring, alpha repair, warping or synthesized intermediate frame is approved.
measurementContract.nativeCoordinateConvention: Cell-local pixels, row-major order. ROIs are [x0,y0,x1,y1] with exclusive right/bottom edges. Ground Y is maxYExclusive for alpha>=64 pixels inside the support ROI.

nativePixelTreatment: None. Both complete native PNGs match their generated originals byte for byte. Inspection crops are diagnostic views outside the candidate, not transformed source exports.
requiredIntegrationChecks: View the native guard/lunge/recovery/close-guard sequence in the actual renderer at normal and close zoom to verify it reads as contact, with coherent grips and no floor jump.
View all four casualty phases and terminal ground-rest under the same 396-pixel reference; check against adjacent v18 ready/fire/march sizes without per-phase normalization.
Inspect real terrain for low-alpha colored fringes and any cross-cell sampling at overview, ordinary and close zoom.
Verify source/review/annotation hashes, missing-phase fallback, protected legacy art/policy behavior, pause/reduced-motion/cold-resume and final scoped-candidate checks before local installation.
limitations: This is independent model-assisted source inspection, not human art, anatomy, historical-drill, injury, usability or production certification.

All selected X pivots and support interpretations are visual registrations of painted anatomy, not physical joint, center-of-mass or measured biomechanics data. Source support points lie in an oblique projected ground plane; every extremity is not required to share a single image Y.

The level contact lunge resembles shouldered aim when isolated. Actual native sequence timing at normal and close zoom must establish useful contact readability before installation; no impact or historically correct bayonet drill is certified.
Recovery and close guard are subtly different poses. Their transition rhythm, hand/weapon continuity and registration stability require actual-renderer playback.

Contact cap-to-sole range is 33/396 = 8.333333333333334 percent, reflecting the bent/wide lunge and guard postures. The old v18 stationary 5/6 percent rule is not applied to these new contact/casualty sources, and no pixels or per-phase scales were changed to flatten that range.

Falling and kneeling silhouettes intentionally shorten under the one contact-derived scale. Relative heads, boots, limbs and equipment were inspected visually; concealed joints, fingers and exact proportions remain uncertified.

Nonzero-alpha noise reaches some cell edges and faint colored fringe remains in native pixels. Alpha>=64 margins are at least 45 pixels, but edge/fringe-free rendering is not certified. Ground and cap measurements exclude alpha below 64 without changing source pixels.
Inspection-only native cell extracts were written outside the candidate for close reading; they were not resampled, used as game textures or substituted for either complete native PNG.

This source-only decision does not accept the integration, renderer playback, pause/cold-resume/reduced-motion behavior, ordinary-PC performance, full infantry family, default policy or final local installation.
